app.name: Plunder & Riffle
app.description: AI-agent lead generation platform. Each agent has their own pitch and niche. Users get 24-hour access by submitting just their email address.
app.audience: Business owners, professionals, and people trying to figure out AI
app.cta: Just your email address — that's all it takes to start
app.style: deadpan mockumentary parody — corporate, dry, self-aware

imageGen.note: Use OPENAI_API_KEY env var. Upgrade to gpt-image-1.5 when available on your tier.

postiz.note: Set POSTIZ_API_KEY env var and fill integration IDs after connecting in Postiz dashboard

revenuecat.note: Set REVENUECAT_API_KEY env var (V2 secret key starting with sk_)
